outcome: Currently meeting the criteria for metabolic syndrome (3 or more of: large waist, high triglycerides, low HDL, high blood pressure, high fasting glucose)

criteria.label: Large waist
criteria.rule: Waist ≥ 102 cm (40 in) for men, ≥ 88 cm (35 in) for women

criteria.label: High triglycerides
criteria.rule: Triglycerides ≥ 150 mg/dL, or on medicine for high triglycerides

criteria.label: Low HDL (“good”) cholesterol
criteria.rule: HDL < 40 mg/dL for men, < 50 mg/dL for women, or on medicine for low HDL

criteria.label: High blood pressure
criteria.rule: Blood pressure ≥ 130/85 mmHg, or on blood-pressure medicine

criteria.label: High fasting blood sugar
criteria.rule: Fasting glucose ≥ 100 mg/dL, or diagnosed diabetes / on glucose-lowering medicine

criteria_agreement.note: Blood pressure is not in the file, so people with 2 measured criteria are labelled by their (unseen) BP.

odds_ratios.unit: men vs women, age 50, waist 98 cm
